_note: The Files API is GA. The `files-api-2025-04-14` beta header was dropped 2026-09-29 after a live check: upload, list and a file-backed message all answer 200 without it. Sending it is not merely redundant -- it selects the OLD list shape (has_more/first_id/last_id) instead of GA's (next_page), so the header changes the response contract, not just the gate.

headers._note: Selects the Workspace this request is billed and rate-limited against. Omitted entirely when the client was given no workspace id, which is the ordinary single-Workspace credential. Only a credential spanning several Workspaces needs it -- and one that omits it there does not fail, it charges the default Workspace silently.
headers.name: anthropic-workspace-id
